A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
N-CWS augments the induction of human LAK cells by the production and action of LHF.

Nocardia rubra CWS (N-CWS), a potent inducer of human lymphokines (LH), augments LAK cell generation by the production of killer helper factor (LHF) from human PBMC in the presence of suboptimal dose rIL-2.
N-CWS is an effective adjuvant in the induction of both LAK and CTL, and the mechanism for this augmentation is the production of LHF by N-CWS-stimulation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
N-CWS can be used as a substitute for rIL-2 in the induction of human LAK cells.
N-CWS is able to induce the production of LHF from PBMC.
N-CWS is a novel and effective immunopotentiator for LAK cell induction, and LHF may play an important role in augmenting the generation of LAK cells.
